areas.name: Sahar & Andheri East
areas.blurb: The airport hotel belt where IBW happens on Nov 1–2: Fairmont, JW Marriott, the Leela, ITC Maratha and Marol's 24-hour coworking. Ballrooms, lawns and hotel dinners.

areas.name: Powai
areas.blurb: Fifteen minutes east of Fairmont along the lake: IIT Bombay, Hiranandani, WeWork, padel and go-karts, and India's largest hotel convention centre. Hackathon country.

areas.name: Santacruz & Vakola
areas.blurb: Between the two anchors on the Western Express Highway: Grand Hyatt's 12 acres and Taj Santacruz. Where an event on Nov 2 evening can catch both crowds.

areas.name: BKC
areas.blurb: Nov 3–6 lives here. Jio World Centre, NMACC and Jio World Garden, walkable hotels (Sofitel, Trident), O Pedro and Yauatcha for dinner, WeWork for workshops.

areas.name: Bandra & Khar
areas.blurb: Fifteen minutes west of BKC: Olive's courtyard parties, Subko's cafés, The Habitat's talk rooms, Taj Lands End on the Sea Link. Intimate community events and afterparties.

areas.name: Juhu
areas.blurb: Sunset on the Arabian Sea, 25 minutes from either anchor. JW Marriott's lawns and Estella's deck are the closest Mumbai gets to a beach-club side event.

areas.name: Lower Parel, Worli & Mahalaxmi
areas.blurb: Forty-five minutes south when traffic behaves: Bombay Canteen, antiSOCIAL, AER, Asilo, G5A, Tote on the Turf, Smaaash. Best for one deliberate destination evening, not the daily default.

areas.name: Kurla & Chembur
areas.blurb: East of BKC along the Santacruz–Chembur Link Road: turfs and padel courts that sit between both anchors on the map, if not on anyone's mental map yet.
